businessModel: Donations and sponsorships; default search partnership; no ads or paid tiers
updateCadence: Roughly weekly patch releases, tracks Firefox security releases within days
summary: Free, open-source Firefox fork with a vertical sidebar, workspaces ("spaces"), folders, split view, Glance and Zen Mods. A popular Arc successor, desktop only, without Widevine DRM.
bestFor: Arc users looking for a successor
Firefox users who want vertical tabs and workspaces
Customizers who like themes and mods
notFor: Anyone who needs Netflix or Widevine DRM
People who need a mobile version
Users who want a fully stable non-beta release

pros.title: Arc-style workflow
pros.detail: Vertical sidebar, spaces, folders, Essentials, split view and Glance previews.

pros.title: Firefox engine and add-ons
pros.detail: Full Firefox add-on catalog with MV2 uBlock Origin and Total Cookie Protection.

pros.title: Zen Mods
pros.detail: Community mods and gradient themes let you restyle the UI.

pros.title: Fast security patching
pros.detail: Ships Firefox security updates within days (1.23.3b moved to Firefox 158 on Oct 16).

pros.title: Open source and free
pros.detail: MPL-2.0 licensed, no ads, no subscription.

cons.title: No official DRM
cons.detail: Zen has not obtained a Widevine license; protected video is unreliable.

cons.title: Desktop only
cons.detail: The team says it has no resources for Android or iOS versions.

cons.title: Still beta
cons.detail: Every release is a "b" build; occasional regressions.

faq.q: Is Zen Browser an Arc replacement?
faq.a: It is the most commonly recommended Arc successor: it has a similar sidebar, spaces, split view and peek-style Glance, though Arc features like Boosts are different.
Not reliably: Zen has not received a Widevine license and its FAQ recommends another browser or the native app for DRM video.

faq.q: Is there a Zen app for phones?
faq.a: No. The team says it lacks the resources and vertical tabs do not translate to mobile; sync with Firefox on your phone instead.

timeline.event: Zen Browser introduced as a Firefox fork

switching.note: Imports from Chrome, Edge, Safari, Firefox; install Firefox add-ons instead of Chrome extensions.
